label: The Boolean difference
subgoals: Cofactor the output with respect to y = 1 and y = 0
XOR the two cofactors to get the Boolean difference
Complement it to get the observability don't care

label: Care sets and counting
subgoals: Evaluate the Boolean difference over the side inputs
Multiply by the number of free input combinations
Combine the care set with controllability to bound the node's freedom

label: Several outputs and reconvergence
subgoals: Compute the ODC of y separately at each output
Intersect them when y feeds several outputs
Use the whole output's Boolean difference when paths reconverge
